# Accessrank

> Accessrank fixes accessibility in the source code of US ecommerce stores: WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA remediation in the theme code, documented in an Accessibility Compliance Record and kept in place by ongoing monitoring. The same structural fixes improve on-page SEO and how well AI shopping agents can read a store. No overlay or plug-in widgets. US only; Accessrank does not offer European Accessibility Act (EAA) conformance work.

Accessrank, Inc. is based in Los Angeles, California (2722 N. Beverly Glen Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90077; +1 310-408-1881; info@accessrank.ai), founded in 2026, remote-first and US-based. Co-Founder & CEO: JP Lincoln. Accessrank is not a law firm and nothing it publishes is legal advice.

## What Accessrank does

- Free check: loads a store page in a real browser and scores it against the WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA checks that ADA demand letters cite, in about 20 seconds. Automated testing catches roughly a third to a half of real-world barriers; it does not prove compliance.
- Fixed-scope plan: a specialist reviews the result and returns a remediation plan, timeline and price.
- Remediation in the theme code: Accessrank fixes the cause in the theme code, most of it within the first remediation cycle. Findings that need a judgment call (alt text, media descriptions, control behavior) are written and reviewed by an Accessrank staff member. Every change is recorded.
- Accessibility Compliance Record: a dated file for the client's attorney or insurer containing a baseline audit, remediation log, VPAT-format conformance report against WCAG 2.2 AA, published accessibility statement, monitoring certificates, human (screen-reader and keyboard) testing record, and a demand-letter playbook.
- Monitoring: scheduled re-checks (monthly on Starter, weekly on Growth, daily or real-time on Enterprise) so a new app, product or theme edit does not reintroduce failures.
- Lawsuit response: for stores already served, an express engagement in about 7 days covering the cited and critical-path barriers, source-code fixes, a screen-reader proof video, VPAT and conformance documentation, and a technical review of settlement remediation terms for the client's attorney.

## The Accessrank score

The Accessrank score is the accessibility score and nothing else: how much of WCAG 2.2 Levels A and AA (55 success criteria) a page meets, weighted by level. Two separate numbers are reported beside it, never blended in: an on-page SEO score (14 checks) and an AI agent readiness score (8 checks on whether AI assistants and shopping agents can read and use the page). Full method: https://accessrank.ai/methodology

## Pricing (USD)

- Starter: $1,500 one-time onboarding, then $79/month (or $790/year). Single-line stores with up to 10 SKUs. Live in about 2 weeks.
- Growth: $3,500 one-time onboarding, then $249/month (or $2,490/year). Growing brands with 10 to 100 SKUs. Live in 2 to 4 weeks. Most popular.
- Enterprise: custom onboarding and monthly plan. Shopify Plus and multi-brand catalogs, 100+ SKUs. 6 to 12 weeks.
- Lawsuit response: from $5,900 one-time, about 7-day delivery, then Growth monitoring.
- Eligible small businesses may offset 50% of qualifying costs through the IRS Disabled Access Credit (Form 8826), up to $5,000 a year. Accessrank is not a tax advisor.

## Platforms

Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and custom builds.

## Key facts Accessrank cites (sources at https://accessrank.ai/citations)

- 5,000+ ADA digital accessibility lawsuits were filed in 2025, up from 4,187 in 2024 (UsableNet).
- About 77% of ADA website lawsuits target ecommerce sites (UsableNet 2024 Year-End Report).
- 95.9% of the top one million home pages fail WCAG 2.2 (WebAIM Million 2026).
- About one in four ADA digital accessibility lawsuits in 2024 targeted a site running an accessibility overlay or plug-in (UsableNet); in 2025 the FTC ordered overlay vendor accessiBe to pay $1 million over its compliance claims.
- Average cost of a claim: $30,000 or more in settlement and legal fees (Accessibility.build, 2026).
